audio_runtime_contract.storage_policy: Keep source audio read-only and decode/resample at training time; any materialized cache must be private.

field_contracts.source: Canonical source/subset name within the dataset.
field_contracts.task: Exactly one of AAC or ASR.
field_contracts.split: Training eligibility split; current Clotho policy permits train only.

audio.contract: Path is source storage. Segment bounds are required for GigaSpeech and absent for whole-file AAC samples.

field_contracts.raw_duration_sec: Positive source sample or segment duration before the 90-second cap.
field_contracts.effective_audio_tokens: Exact dynamic token count under the canonical 16-kHz planner; never pad short samples to 250 tokens.
field_contracts.targets: Non-empty list of valid references. Runtime emits exactly one selected target for each training occurrence.
field_contracts.metadata: Dataset-specific provenance only; training prompts/messages are rendered later by task.

clotho_v2_aac.target_policy: Keep references grouped per audio, but select exactly one caption for each training occurrence.

sampling_contract.loss_weighting: No additional task or dataset loss weights in the initial run.
